title: Judge Anything: MLLM as a Judge Across Any Modality
authors_zh: Shu Pu、Yaochen Wang、Dongping Chen、Yuhang Chen、Guohao Wang、Qi Qin、Zhongyi Zhang、Zhiyuan Zhang、Zetong Zhou、Shuang Gong、Yi Gui、Yao Wan、Philip S. Yu
paper_type_zh: 评测、裁判或量规数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要构建、校准或审计开放式模型评测的研究者。
one_line: JudgeAnything benchmarks multimodal judges across any-to-any tasks with human judgments, rubrics, and pairwise or score-based protocols.
JudgeAnything 以人工判定、量规及成对或评分协议，评测多模态模型在任意模态任务上的评判能力。
why: JudgeAnything benchmarks multimodal judges across any-to-any tasks with human judgments, rubrics, and pairwise or score-based protocols.
inclusion_reason: JudgeAnything 以人工判定、量规及成对或评分协议，评测多模态模型在任意模态任务上的评判能力。

title: Problem
问题
html: Existing multimodal evaluation mainly focuses on image-text understanding and often assumes an image input with a textual output. It therefore cannot uniformly handle arbitrary combinations of audio, video, image, and text. Open-ended multimodal generation also lacks unique references, while text-only judges cannot inspect the original media and are vulnerable to cross-modal bias and hallucination. The paper asks both what current omni-models can do on any-to-any tasks and whether they can reliably judge such outputs like humans.
现有多模态自动评测主要集中在图文理解，通常假设输入是图像、输出是文本，难以统一处理音频、视频、图像与文本之间的任意输入输出组合。开放式多模态生成还缺少唯一参考答案，单一文本裁判无法直接观察原始媒体，因此容易受跨模态偏差和幻觉影响。论文研究两个问题：当前全模态模型究竟能完成哪些 any-to-any 任务，以及它们能否像人类一样可靠评价这些任务的回答。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper introduces two complementary benchmarks. TaskAnything curates 1,500 queries from established datasets across 15 any-to-any modality categories to assess multimodal understanding and generation. JudgeAnything adds candidate outputs, human judgments, and detailed rubrics to evaluate five advanced MLLMs under pairwise comparison and score evaluation. The authors also release OmniArena, a unified platform for continuously evaluating omni-models and multimodal reward models.

论文提出两个互补 benchmark：TaskAnything 从成熟数据集中整理 1,500 个查询，覆盖 15 类 any-to-any 模态组合，用于测模型本身的多模态理解与生成能力；JudgeAnything 则加入候选回答、人类偏好和详细 rubric，从成对比较与绝对打分两种协议评测 5 个先进 MLLM 的裁判能力。作者还发布 OmniArena，用统一接口持续评测 omni-model 与多模态 reward model。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Curate tasks: Queries are selected from established image, audio, video, and text benchmarks and normalized into 15 input-output modality categories.
  2. Generate candidates: Multiple advanced MLLMs answer the 1,500 TaskAnything queries, preserving the original media, instruction, and model output.
  3. Build the judge set: Detailed rubrics and human pairwise preferences and scores are collected for representative outputs to create JudgeAnything.
  4. Unified evaluation: Judges receive both the task input and candidate outputs, perform pairwise comparison and absolute scoring, and are compared with human labels.
  5. Release the platform: OmniArena packages model invocation, media presentation, and automated evaluation; the project page provides data, code, and leaderboard access.

1. 任务整理：从已有图像、音频、视频和文本 benchmark 中筛选查询，统一成 15 种输入—输出模态类别。
  2. 生成候选：调用多种先进 MLLM 完成 1,500 个 TaskAnything 查询，保存原始媒体、指令与模型回答。
  3. 构造裁判集：为代表性回答建立详细 rubric，并收集人类的 pairwise preference 与 score，形成 JudgeAnything。
  4. 统一评测：要求裁判同时访问任务输入和候选输出，分别执行成对比较和绝对评分，再与人类标签计算一致性。
  5. 平台发布：OmniArena 封装模型调用、媒体展示和自动评价；项目页开放数据、代码与排行榜入口。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Five advanced MLLMs are evaluated. On multimodal understanding, average human agreement is 66.55% for pairwise comparison and 42.79% for score evaluation; on multimodal generation, it falls to 53.37% and 30.05%, respectively. This gap shows that judging ability is substantially weaker than apparent task performance and exposes cross-modal bias and hallucination. The coverage of many modality combinations and two protocols supports the generality of the issue, although five models and 1,500 tasks cannot represent every emerging omni-model.

作者评测 5 个先进 MLLM。对多模态理解任务，裁判平均人类一致率在成对比较中为 66.55%，绝对评分中为 42.79%；对多模态生成任务则分别降至 53.37% 和 30.05%。该差距表明模型作为 judge 的能力明显弱于作为任务执行者的表面表现，并暴露跨模态偏置与幻觉。结果覆盖多种模态组合和两类评价协议，支持问题的普遍性，但 5 个模型和 1,500 个任务仍不足以代表所有新型 omni-model。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier MLLM-as-a-judge benchmarks mainly covered visual question answering, image captioning, or one output modality and could not compare cross-modal judging such as evaluating video from audio or text from video. This work unifies a capability benchmark, a judge benchmark, and a continual evaluation platform, allowing judges to inspect arbitrary input and output modalities. Human preferences, rubrics, and pairwise evaluation are not new; the main advance is modality coverage and a unified interface.
此前的 MLLM-as-a-judge benchmark 多围绕视觉问答、图像描述或单一输出模态，无法比较“音频评视频”“视频评文本”等跨模态裁判。该论文的新意是把任务能力 benchmark、裁判能力 benchmark 和持续评测平台统一起来，并让 judge 直接面向任意模态输入输出。使用人类偏好、rubric 和 pairwise 评价本身并不新；真正扩展的是模态覆盖与统一评价接口。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Modality boundary: The 15 categories still inherit existing benchmarks and cover streaming speech, very long video, and multi-file mixtures only weakly.
  2. Human-label cost: Open-ended multimodal quality is subjective, and majority preference can hide cultural or use-case differences; annotator disagreement should be reported.
  3. Rapid model turnover: Conclusions come from five models at one point in time, so the leaderboard can age quickly and needs hidden tests and continual additions.
  4. Judge accessibility: Closed models differ in media-input restrictions, and protocol differences may be mistaken for capability differences.

1. 模态覆盖边界：15 类组合仍依赖现有 benchmark，真实交互中的流式语音、超长视频和多文件混合输入覆盖有限。
  2. 人类标签成本：开放式多模态质量具有主观性，单一多数偏好可能掩盖文化和用途差异；应报告标注者分歧。
  3. 模型快速迭代：结论来自 5 个特定时期的模型，排行榜容易过时；需要隐藏测试和持续补充新系统。
  4. 裁判可访问性：部分闭源模型对音视频输入的限制不同，协议差异可能被误当成能力差异。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The work can serve as a unified regression suite for omni-models and multimodal reward models: TaskAnything measures task capability, while JudgeAnything tests whether automated evaluation is trustworthy. The data can train criterion-conditioned judges that consume image, audio, and video, or analyze calibration differences between pairwise and scoring modes. Image-text products may use the relevant subset, whereas high-stakes review requires domain experts, verifiable metrics, and human arbitration.

该工作可作为全模态模型和多模态奖励模型的统一回归测试：先用 TaskAnything 检查任务能力，再用 JudgeAnything 检查自动评价是否可信。数据还可用于训练支持图像、音频和视频输入的 criterion-conditioned judge，或分析同一模型在 pairwise 与 score 模式下的校准差异。若产品只处理图文任务，可选择对应子集；若用于高风险审核，则必须加入领域专家、可验证指标和人工仲裁。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence positioning: It extends MLLM-as-a-judge from image-text tasks to arbitrary input and output modalities.
  2. Method takeaway: 1,500 tasks, 15 modality combinations, human judgments, detailed rubrics, and two evaluation protocols.
  3. Data takeaway: TaskAnything measures task capability, JudgeAnything measures judging ability, and OmniArena supports continual evaluation.
  4. Evidence anchor: Average judge agreement on multimodal generation is substantially lower than on understanding.
  5. Reuse decision: It is useful for omni-modal evaluation and reward-model research, but closed-model rankings are not durable conclusions.

1. 一句话定位：把 MLLM-as-a-judge 从图文扩展到任意模态输入输出。
  2. 方法抓手：1,500 个任务、15 种模态组合、人类判断、详细 rubric 和两类评价协议。
  3. 数据抓手：TaskAnything 测任务能力，JudgeAnything 测裁判能力，OmniArena 支持持续评测。
  4. 证据锚点：多模态生成的平均 judge 一致率显著低于理解任务。
  5. 复用决定：适合全模态评测与 reward model 研究；不能把闭源模型排行榜视为长期结论。
